knowledge:
- key_parameters: type=Specifies the input format in loadGeneLists ("GMT" for a single GMT file or "DIR" for a directory of files) ;; header=Logical indicating if files in the directory have a header line ;; col=Integer specifying which column contains the genes in directory files ;; use_archived=Logical indicating whether to use the pre-packaged archived GO terms (faster) or fetch the latest from BioMart ;; species=Target species for GO annotation ("human", "mouse", or "rat") ;; domain=GO domain to load ("BP" for biological process, "CC" for cellular component, or "MF" for molecular function) ;; min_num_genes=Minimum number of genes associated with a GO term to keep it ;; filter_method=Method to filter GO terms in performGOEnrichment ("p.adjust" or nominal p-value) ;; significance_threshold=Significance threshold for filtering enriched GO terms ;; p.adjust_method=P-value adjustment method (e.g., "BH") ;; distance_method=Distance metric for hierarchical clustering (e.g., "euclidean" or correlation-based) ;; clustering_method=Agglomeration method for hclust (e.g., "complete", "average") ;; feature=Whether to cluster rows ("row") or columns ("col") ;; distance_threshold=Height threshold for cutting the dendrogram to group clusters ;; min_num_terms=Minimum number of GO terms in a cluster required to display its label in the heatmap
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation, though manual curation and Venn diagrams are noted as impractical for large datasets.
- when_to_use: Use this workflow when you have multiple gene lists (e.g., differentially expressed genes across multiple time points, treatments, or conditions) and want to systematically compare, cluster, and visualize their enriched GO terms using representative subtree-based annotations.
- pitfalls: Fetching live GO terms from BioMart (use_archived = FALSE) can take several minutes. Setting the distance_threshold too high or too low in groupClusters can result in either too few massive clusters or too many tiny clusters.

workflows.name: gostag_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform GO enrichment on multiple gene lists, cluster and group the enriched GO terms, annotate the clusters using representative subtree terms, and visualize the results in a heatmap.
input: gene_lists.gmt (Tab-delimited GMT file containing one gene list per line)
/gene/lists/directory (Directory containing separate tab-delimited text files with gene lists)
workflows.stages: 1. Load gene lists using loadGeneLists ;; 2. Load GO terms and gene associations using loadGOTerms ;; 3. Generate the enrichment matrix using performGOEnrichment ;; 4. Perform hierarchical clustering on GO terms and samples using performHierarchicalClustering ;; 5. Group the clustered GO terms into distinct clusters using groupClusters ;; 6. Annotate the clusters with representative GO terms using annotateClusters ;; 7. Visualize the results as a heatmap using plotHeatmap
workflows.code:
gene_lists <- loadGeneLists( "gene_lists.gmt" )
go_terms <- loadGOTerms()
enrichment_matrix <- performGOEnrichment( goSTAG_example_gene_lists, go_terms )
hclust_results <- performHierarchicalClustering( enrichment_matrix )
hclust_results_euclidean <- performHierarchicalClustering( enrichment_matrix, distance_method = "euclidean", clustering_method = "complete" )
sample_hclust_results <- performHierarchicalClustering( enrichment_matrix, feature = "col" )
clusters <- groupClusters( hclust_results_euclidean )
cluster_labels <- annotateClusters( clusters )
plotHeatmap( enrichment_matrix, hclust_results_euclidean, clusters, cluster_labels )
plotHeatmap( enrichment_matrix, hclust_results_euclidean, clusters, cluster_labels, sample_hclust_results = sample_hclust_results )
